summary: Figure Technology Solutions acquired Kiavi via merger, with Kiavi surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary. The cash consideration, net of cash acquired, was approximately $590 million, funded by $600 million of 8.500% Senior Notes due 2031 issued July 14, 2026. The merger closed September 1, 2026, following the June 10, 2026 agreement. Kiavi’s credit facility was repaid and a repurchase agreement terminated at closing. The deal adds Kiavi’s technology platform and DSCR loans. Watch for integration execution and post-closing working capital adjustments.
